overview: Black replies to 2.f4 with 2...Qf6, protecting e5 and aiming at f4 and the queenside, at the cost of an early queen move. White gets a lead in development with 3.Nc3 Qxf4 4.d4 (Schubert) or 4.Nf3 Bb4 5.Bc4 (Bücker Gambit), where the black queen is chased and the f-pawn is a gambit pawn. Black has an extra pawn but the queen is exposed.

white_ideas.idea: Develop with Nc3, d4 and Nf3 while the black queen is out
Attack the exposed queen on f4 and use the open f-file and the e-file
Play Bc4 and castle quickly for an attack on f7

black_ideas.idea: Take on f4 with the queen and hold the extra pawn
Develop with ...Bb4 and ...Nc6 and defend f7
Return the pawn to complete development

typical_structures.structure: Open e-file and f-file with a black queen on f4
White d4/e4 centre against ...exd4 or a queen on f6

character.notes: The early queen move makes it forcing: White develops with tempi on the queen.

gambit.notes: After 3.Nc3 Qxf4 White has given the f-pawn for development and Black can keep it; in the quieter 3.fxe5 Qxe5 nothing is given. I read the gambit lines as the main ones.

soundness.notes: Considered dubious for Black: the early queen costs time.

structure.notes: Open lines for the pieces after the f- and e-pawns exchange: open.

approach.notes: Seldom played by strong players, hence offbeat.

level.notes: It is dubious, so not for beginners.

sublines_that_differ.name: Schubert Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 Qf6 3. Nc3 Qxf4 4. d4
sublines_that_differ.how: White offers the pawn for central control and development.

sublines_that_differ.name: Bücker Gambit
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. f4 Qf6 3. Nc3 Qxf4 4. Nf3 Bb4 5. Bc4
sublines_that_differ.how: White sacrifices more material for an attack on f7.

character.reason: An early queen move and gambit play with forcing tactics.

gambit.reason: The main lines let Black take f4 with the queen; the root itself gives nothing.

soundness.reason: The early queen move is considered inferior.

structure.reason: The e- and f-files and the centre open early.

plans.reason: The black queen comes out early and White develops with tempo.
